stages.effectText: Attacks all enemies within range, and deals 160% damage to enemies in the row directly in front of this unit.

When deployed, Ch'en's ammo -based skills have 23% chance to not consume the corresponding ammo; other Sniper Operators ' ammo-based skills have 20% chance instead, while other Ranged Operators have 8% chance (only the highest effect of this type will be applied)

When deployed, Ch'en's ammo-based skills have 25% chance to not consume the corresponding ammo; other Sniper Operators' ammo-based skills have 20% chance instead, while other Ranged Operators have 12% chance (only the highest effect of this type will be applied)
